authors.institution: School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University

title_en: FormAct: Agentic Source Editing for Rich-Format Document Generation
title_zh: FormAct：通过智能体式源文件编辑生成富格式文档

sentences.en: Rich-format documents are essential for everyday operations yet costly to author, motivating the need for automated generation to enhance productivity.
sentences.zh: 富格式文档对日常运作至关重要，但编写成本高昂，因此需要自动化生成以提升生产力。

sentences.en: To this end, we present FormAct, an agentic system that generates professional rich-format documents from scratch.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出 FormAct，一个从零开始生成专业富格式文档的智能体式系统。

sentences.en: FormAct operates on an HTML source representation and performs iterative source refinement with an *editing agent* that invokes a suite of tools, including a syntax-aware source editor and a template retriever, and a *review agent* that critiques rendered pages to guide refinement.
sentences.zh: FormAct 采用 HTML 源表征，并通过迭代式源精化进行操作：*编辑智能体*（editing agent）调用一系列工具，包括语法感知的源编辑器与模板检索器；*评审智能体*（review agent）则批判已渲染页面以指导精化。

sentences.en: Additionally, we incorporate edit-triggered context compression to maintain a bounded working context and keep multi-round editing efficient.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入编辑触发的上下文压缩，以维持有界的工作上下文，并使多轮编辑保持高效。

sentences.en: To support development and evaluation, we introduce RichDocBench for end-to-end generation, and RichDocFuzz to evaluate formatting-error recognition for reviewer agents.
sentences.zh: 为支持开发与评估，我们推出用于端到端生成的 RichDocBench，以及用于评估评审智能体格式化错误识别能力的 RichDocFuzz。

sentences.en: Through extensive automated evaluation and blind human-preference studies, we show that FormAct consistently outperforms strong baselines, including Codex-CLI, with particularly strong improvements in generating error-free, professional rich-format documents.
sentences.zh: 通过广泛的自动化评估与盲法人类偏好研究，我们表明 FormAct 持续优于包括 Codex-CLI 在内的强基线，在生成无错误、专业的富格式文档方面提升尤为显著。

title_en: Formal Concept Lattices are Good Semantic Scaffolds for Concept-Based Learning
title_zh: 形式概念格是基于概念学习的良好语义支架

sentences.en: Learning semantics is essential for deep learning models to be interpretable and better aligned with human reasoning.
sentences.zh: 学习语义对于深度学习模型具有可解释性并更好地与人类推理对齐至关重要。

sentences.en: Concept-based models approach this by representing classes through meaningful semantic abstractions, but typically treat all concepts as a flat, unstructured set learned at a single neural network layer.
sentences.zh: 基于概念的方法通过有意义的语义抽象来表征类别，但通常将所有概念视为在单个神经网络层中学到的一个扁平、无结构集合。

sentences.en: This overlooks a fundamental property of human semantic understanding: concepts being organized hierarchically, from general to specific.
sentences.zh: 这忽视了人类语义理解的一个基本特性：概念是按层次组织的，从一般到具体。

sentences.en: While deep networks do learn a hierarchy of visual features, this structure is rarely aligned with explicit semantic hierarchies.
sentences.zh: 虽然深度网络确实能学习视觉特征的层次结构，但这种结构很少与显式语义层次对齐。

sentences.en: Drawing on Formal Concept Analysis, we demonstrate that formal concept lattices provide principled semantic scaffolds to guide neural network learning.
sentences.zh: 借鉴形式概念分析（Formal Concept Analysis），我们证明形式概念格为引导神经网络学习提供了原则性的语义脚手架。

sentences.en: These lattices naturally identify where in the network concepts should be learned based on their level of generality.
sentences.zh: 这些格自然地指出了网络中的哪些位置应根据概念的概括程度来学习概念。

sentences.en: This allows the model to develop staged, semantically grounded representations throughout its depth.
sentences.zh: 这使得模型能够在其深度上发展出分阶段的、语义扎实的表征。

sentences.en: Empirical results on real-world datasets show that our models produce more interpretable embeddings, support more effective interventions, and learn concept representations that are both meaningful and hierarchically structured.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界数据集上的实证结果表明，我们的模型产生了更具可解释性的嵌入，支持更有效的干预，并学习了既有意义又具有层次结构的概念表征。

title_en: Formalizing and Falsifying Causal Pathways of Rare Events
title_zh: 形式化并证伪罕见事件的因果路径

sentences.en: Building on recent formalizations of root cause analysis for rare events (“outliers”) in structural equation models, we propose a formal definition of a causal pathway and discuss its testable implications.
sentences.zh: 基于对结构方程模型中稀有事件（“异常值”）根因分析的近期形式化研究，我们提出了因果通路的形式化定义，并讨论了其可检验的含义。

sentences.en: We identify conditions under which these implications depend only on a causal abstraction defined by the pathway of rare events, rather than on the full causal graph of the underlying system.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出使这些含义仅依赖于由稀有事件通路所定义的因果抽象、而非底层系统完整因果图的条件。

sentences.en: Accordingly, we introduce an abstraction of causal structure to pathways of rare events that bridges simple verbal causal explanations and detailed causal modeling.
sentences.zh: 据此，我们将因果结构抽象为稀有事件通路，从而在简洁的言语性因果解释与详细的因果建模之间架起桥梁。

title_en: Formalizing Learning from Language Feedback with Provable Guarantees
title_zh: 以可证明保证形式化语言反馈学习

sentences.en: Interactively learning from observation and language feedback is an increasingly studied area driven by the emergence of large language model (LLM) agents.
sentences.zh: 受大语言模型（LLM）智能体出现的驱动，从观测与语言反馈中交互式学习正成为一个日益受关注的研究领域。

sentences.en: While impressive empirical demonstrations have been shown, so far a principled framing of these decision problems remains lacking.
sentences.zh: 尽管已展示出令人印象深刻的实证效果，但迄今为止，对这些决策问题的原则性框架仍然缺失。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formalize the Learning from Language Feedback (LLF) problem, assert sufficient assumptions to enable learning despite latent rewards, and introduce *transfer eluder dimension* as a measure to characterize the hardness of LLF problems.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们形式化了从语言反馈学习（LLF）问题，给出了在存在潜在奖励的情况下仍能学习的充分假设，并引入 *迁移 eluder 维度*（transfer eluder dimension）作为刻画 LLF 问题难度的度量。

sentences.en: We formalize the intuition that information in the feedback governs the learning complexity of LLF problems.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化了“反馈中的信息主导 LLF 问题学习复杂度”这一直觉。

sentences.en: We demonstrate cases where learning from rich language feedback can be exponentially faster than learning from reward.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了在若干情形下，从丰富语言反馈中学习可能比从奖励中学习呈指数级更快。

sentences.en: We develop a no-regret algorithm, called `HELiX`, that provably solves LLF problems through sequential interactions, with performance guarantees that scale with the transfer eluder dimension of the problem.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了一种称为 `HELiX` 的无后悔算法，通过序列交互可证明地解决 LLF 问题，其性能保证随问题的迁移 eluder 维度扩展。

sentences.en: Across several empirical domains, we show that `HELiX` performs well even when repeatedly prompting LLMs does not work reliably.
sentences.zh: 在多个实证领域中，我们表明即使在反复提示 LLM 无法可靠工作的情况下，`HELiX` 也能表现得很好。

sentences.en: Our contributions mark an important step towards designing principled interactive learning algorithms from generic language feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们的贡献标志着朝向从通用语言反馈设计原则性交互学习算法迈出的重要一步。

title_en: Formalizing the Binding Problem
title_zh: 形式化绑定问题

sentences.en: Representations of the world, arguably, contain information about features (e.g. something is blue, something is a circle) but also information about which features are part of the same object (e.g. the circle is blue), which we call binding information.
sentences.zh: 可以说，对世界的表征既包含有关特征的信息（例如某物是蓝色的、某物是圆形），也包含关于哪些特征属于同一对象的信息（例如“那个圆形是蓝色的”），我们将后者称为绑定信息。

sentences.en: Any system with the ability to understand scenes with multiple objects must be able to solve the binding problem: it needs to know which features belong together.
sentences.zh: 任何能够理解含多个对象场景的系统，都必须能够解决绑定问题：它需要知道哪些特征属于同一组。

sentences.en: However, despite work showing that Vision Transformers (ViTs) know which patches belong together, it is not known whether current deep learning models learn to exhibit binding information, i.e., for features.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管已有研究表明 Vision Transformer（ViT）知道哪些补丁属于同一组，但目前仍不清楚当前的深度学习模型是否学会了展现绑定信息，即对于特征而言。

sentences.en: We may believe that there is not much binding information, after all misattributing features to wrong objects is a common failure of ViT-based architectures, especially in scenes with objects sharing features.
sentences.zh: 我们可能认为绑定信息并不多，毕竟将特征错误归属到错误对象是 ViT 架构的常见失败，尤其是在包含共享特征对象的场景中。

sentences.en: Here we formalize the binding problem with an information-theoretic approach, and introduce a probing method to measure binding information in model representations.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们以信息论方法形式化绑定问题，并引入一种探针方法来度量模型表征中的绑定信息。

sentences.en: We perform experiments on ViTs, measuring binding from different components of the architecture, such as the image summary token [CLS] or the spatial tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们对 ViT 进行了实验，从架构的不同组件（如图像摘要 token [CLS] 或空间 token）来度量绑定情况。

sentences.en: We use datasets with different binding challenges, such as feature sharing, occlusion, and natural features, while comparing the performance of several pre-trained ViTs.
sentences.zh: 我们使用了具有不同绑定挑战的数据集，例如特征共享、遮挡和自然特征，同时比较了多种预训练 ViT 的性能。

sentences.en: Overall, our research demonstrates binding as a key ingredient to strong visual recognition and reasoning.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究表明绑定是强视觉识别与推理的关键要素。

title_en: FormalJudge: A Neuro-Symbolic Paradigm for Agentic Oversight
title_zh: FormalJudge：智能体监督的神经符号范式

sentences.en: As LLM-based agents increasingly operate in high-stakes domains with real-world consequences, ensuring their behavioral safety becomes paramount.
sentences.zh: 随着基于 LLM 的智能体越来越多地运作于具有真实世界后果的高风险领域，确保其行为安全变得至关重要。

sentences.en: The dominant oversight paradigm, *LLM-as-a-Judge*, faces a fundamental dilemma: how can probabilistic systems reliably supervise other probabilistic systems without inheriting their failure modes?
sentences.zh: 占主导地位的监督范式 *以 LLM 作为评审*（LLM-as-a-Judge）面临一个根本困境：概率系统如何能够在不同时继承其失败模式的情况下，可靠地监督其他概率系统？

sentences.en: We argue that formal verification offers a principled escape from this dilemma, yet its adoption has been hindered by a critical bottleneck: the translation from natural language requirements to formal specifications.
sentences.zh: 我们认为形式化验证为摆脱这一困境提供了原则性的出路，然而其采纳一直受到一个关键瓶颈的阻碍：从自然语言需求到形式规范（formal specifications）的翻译。

sentences.en: This paper bridges this gap by proposing , a neuro-symbolic framework that employs a bidirectional **Formal-of-Thought** architecture: LLMs serve as *specification compilers* that top-down decompose high-level human intent into atomic, verifiable constraints, then bottom-up prove compliance using Dafny specifications and Z3 Satisfiability modulo theories solving, which produces mathematical guarantees rather than probabilistic scores.
sentences.zh: 本文通过提出一个神经符号框架来弥合这一鸿沟，该框架采用双向 **Formal-of-Thought** 架构：LLM 充当 *规范编译器*（specification compilers），自上而下地将高层人类意图分解为原子、可验证的约束，然后使用 Dafny 规范与 Z3 可满足性模理论（SMT）求解自下而上的证明合规性，从而产生数学保证而非概率分数。

sentences.en: We validate across three benchmarks spanning behavioral safety, multi-domain constraint adherence, and agentic upward deception detection.
sentences.zh: 我们在覆盖行为安全、多领域约束遵从与智能体向上欺骗检测三个基准上进行了验证。

sentences.en: Experiments on 7 agent models demonstrate that achieves an average improvement of **16.6%** over LLM-as-a-Judge baselines, enables *weak-to-strong* generalization where a 7B judge achieves over 90% accuracy detecting deception from 72B agents, and provides *near-linear safety improvement* through iterative refinement.
sentences.zh: 在 7 个智能体模型上的实验表明，本框架与 LLM-as-a-Judge 基线相比实现了平均 **16.6%** 的提升，实现了 *弱到强*（weak-to-strong）泛化——一个 7B 评审器能够以超过 90% 的准确率检测 72B 智能体的欺骗——并通过迭代式精化提供了 *近似线性的安全提升*。

title_en: Formally Exploring Visual Anomaly Detection Evaluation Metrics
title_zh: 形式化探索视觉异常检测评估指标

sentences.en: Inaccurate Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) can lead to critical failures in safety-sensitive domains, including autonomous navigation and industrial surveillance.
sentences.zh: 不准确的视觉异常检测（VAD）可能导致安全敏感领域（包括自主导航与工业监控）中的关键失效。

sentences.en: With the increasing abundance and rapid proliferation of VAD algorithms, their reliable evaluation has become increasingly important and challenging.
sentences.zh: 随着 VAD 算法数量的不断增加与快速涌现，对其进行可靠评估已变得日益重要且具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Commonly used evaluation metrics often fail to capture practically relevant aspects of model behavior, yielding inconsistent or misleading assessments by overlooking errors such as redundant detections and the spatial distribution of false positives.
sentences.zh: 常用的评估指标往往无法捕捉模型行为中与实践相关的方面，往往忽略冗余检测与假阳性的空间分布等错误，从而产生不一致或误导性的评估结果。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formalize the requirements for VAD evaluation by introducing a set of axiomatic, verifiable properties that an evaluation metric should satisfy.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过引入一组评估指标应满足的公理化、可验证属性，来形式化 VAD 评估的需求。

sentences.en: Through a systematic analysis of state-of-the-art evaluation methods, we show that none satisfies all proposed properties.
sentences.zh: 通过对最先进评估方法的系统分析，我们表明没有任何一种方法能满足所有提出的属性。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce SAAM-ALARM, a novel evaluation metric that satisfies these properties.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们引入 SAAM-ALARM，一种满足这些属性的新颖评估指标。

sentences.en: Our results show that SAAM-ALARM provides a more nuanced and theoretically sound assessment, establishing a stronger standard for performance benchmarking in VAD.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，SAAM-ALARM 提供了更细致且理论上更可靠的评估，为 VAD 的性能基准评测建立了更强的标准。

title_en: FormalRx: Rectify and eXamine Semantic Failures in Autoformalization
title_zh: FormalRx：纠正并检查自动形式化中的语义失效

sentences.en: The veracious semantic alignment in autoformalization is significant for formal mathematical reasoning.
sentences.zh: 自动形式化中可靠的语义对齐对于形式数学推理具有重要意义。

sentences.en: However, existing evaluations provide only opaque binary verdicts or scalar scores, offering no interpretable insight into where or why translations fail.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的评估仅提供不透明的二元判定或标量分数，无法就翻译在何处、为何失败提供可解释的洞见。

sentences.en: This opacity severely limits both human understanding and automated system improvement.
sentences.zh: 这种不透明性严重限制了人类理解与自动化系统的改进。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce FormalRx, a comprehensive diagnostic evaluation framework that transforms autoformalization assessment from black-box judgments into actionable feedback.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们引入 FormalRx，一个全面的诊断式评估框架，它将自动形式化评估从黑盒判定转变为可操作的反馈。

sentences.en: At its core is SCI Error Taxonomy, a hierarchical classification scheme decomposing autoformalization errors into 28 distinct categories with strict priority ordering.
sentences.zh: 其核心是 SCI 错误分类法（SCI Error Taxonomy），一种层次化分类方案，将自动形式化错误分解为 28 个具有严格优先级排序的不同类别。

sentences.en: Building on this taxonomy, FormalRx provides four critical diagnostic capabilities: alignment verdicts, error categorization, error localization, and correction.
sentences.zh: 基于这一分类法，FormalRx 提供了四种关键的诊断能力：对齐判定、错误分类、错误定位与修正。

sentences.en: We instantiate the framework with a diagnostic model FormalRx-8B, trained on 56,287 synthetically generated samples with fine-grained diagnostic annotations, and release FormalRx-Test as the first fine-grained diagnostic benchmark.
sentences.zh: 我们用诊断模型 FormalRx-8B 实例化该框架，该模型在 56,287 个带细粒度诊断注释的合成样本上训练，并发布了 FormalRx-Test 作为首个细粒度诊断基准。

sentences.en: FormalRx-8B achieves F1-scores of 0.88 (verdict) and 0.71 (categorization), along with accuracies of 0.75 (localization) and 0.73 (correction), substantially outperforming both general-purpose LLMs and specialized baselines.
sentences.zh: FormalRx-8B 在判定上达到 0.88 的 F1 分数、在分类上达到 0.71，同时定位准确率为 0.75、修正准确率为 0.73，大幅优于通用 LLM 与专门基线。

sentences.en: By connecting evaluation with actionable insights, FormalRx enables systematic diagnosis and improvement of autoformalization systems.
sentences.zh: 通过将评估与可操作的洞见相连接，FormalRx 实现了对自动形式化系统的系统性诊断与改进。

title_en: FormulaCode: Evaluating Agentic Optimization on Large Codebases
title_zh: FormulaCode：评估大型代码库上的智能体优化

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate at the repository level, motivating benchmarks that evaluate their ability to optimize entire codebases under realistic constraints.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）编码智能体日益在仓库层面运作，这促使我们需要能够评估其在现实约束下优化整个代码库能力的基准。

sentences.en: Existing code benchmarks largely rely on synthetic tasks, binary correctness signals, or single-objective evaluation, limiting their ability to assess holistic optimization behavior.
sentences.zh: 现有的代码基准大多依赖合成任务、二元正确性信号或单目标评估，限制了其评估整体优化行为的能力。

sentences.en: We introduce FormulaCode, a benchmark for evaluating agentic optimization on large, real-world codebases with fine-grained, multi-objective performance metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 FormulaCode，一个在大型真实世界代码库上以细粒度、多目标性能指标评估智能体式优化的基准。

sentences.en: FormulaCode comprises 957 performance bottlenecks mined from scientific Python repositories on GitHub, each paired with expert-authored patches and 264.6 community-maintained performance workloads per task, enabling evaluation of the full optimization lifecycle—triage, diagnosis, and resolution—under realistic correctness and performance constraints.
sentences.zh: FormulaCode 包含从 GitHub 上的科学 Python 仓库中挖掘出的 957 个性能瓶颈，每个瓶颈都配有专家撰写的补丁，每个任务附带 264.6 个由社区维护的性能工作负载，从而能够在现实的正确性与性能约束下评估完整的优化生命周期——分诊、诊断与解决。

sentences.en: Our evaluations reveal that repository-scale, multi-objective optimization remains a major challenge for frontier LLM agents.
sentences.zh: 我们的评估表明，仓库规模的、多目标的优化仍然是前沿 LLM 智能体面临的一项重大挑战。

title_en: Forward-Chaining Temporal Point Process
title_zh: 前向链式时间点过程

sentences.en: Event sequences from complex systems, such as clinical workflows, are often sparse and incomplete.
sentences.zh: 来自复杂系统（如临床工作流）的事件序列往往稀疏且不完整。

sentences.en: As a result, downstream models are trained on data that only partially captures the underlying dynamics.
sentences.zh: 因此，下游模型只能基于部分捕获底层动态的数据进行训练。

sentences.en: Synthetic sequence generation can augment real data by filling in missing structure and improving coverage of rare patterns, but generated trajectories must remain realistic, satisfy domain constraints, and allow control.
sentences.zh: 合成序列生成可以通过填补缺失结构并改善稀有模式的覆盖来扩增真实数据，但生成的轨迹必须保持真实、满足领域约束，并允许控制。

sentences.en: We propose the Forward-Chaining Temporal Point Process (FC-TPP), a framework for constraint-aware and controllable sequence generation in continuous time.
sentences.zh: 我们提出前向链式时间点过程（Forward-Chaining Temporal Point Process，FC-TPP），一个面向连续时间中约束感知且可控的序列生成框架。

sentences.en: FC-TPP maintains an explicit latent symbolic state encoding high-level predicates, which evolves through a differentiable multi-hop forward-chaining operator.
sentences.zh: FC-TPP 维护一个编码高层谓词的显式潜在符号状态，该状态通过一个可微的多跳前向链式算子演化。

sentences.en: Logical rules update the latent state based on recent events, while a temporal point process decoder generates future event times and types conditioned on this evolving state.
sentences.zh: 逻辑规则基于近期事件更新潜在状态，而时间点过程解码器基于这一演化中的状态生成未来事件时间与类型。

sentences.en: By tying the generative dynamics to multi-hop reasoning in latent space, FC-TPP incorporates symbolic structure throughout generation rather than relying directly on raw event histories.
sentences.zh: 通过将生成动力学与潜空间中的多跳推理相联系，FC-TPP 在整个生成过程中融入符号结构，而非直接依赖原始事件历史。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic data and four semi-synthetic/real-world benchmarks—LogiCity, MIMIC-IV, EPIC-100, and IKEA ASM—show that FC-TPP achieves higher generation quality under limited and incomplete data, with stronger constraint adherence and greater controllability than purely neural and prior neuro-symbolic baselines.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据与四个半合成/真实世界基准——LogiCity、MIMIC-IV、EPIC-100 和 IKEA ASM——上的实验表明，FC-TPP 在数据有限且不完整的条件下实现了更高的生成质量，并且在约束遵从性与可控性方面优于纯神经方法与先前的神经符号基线。

title_en: Forward-KL Convergence of Time-Inhomogeneous Langevin Diffusions
title_zh: 时变 Langevin 扩散的前向 KL 收敛性

sentences.en: Many practical samplers rely on time-dependent drifts---often induced by annealing or tempering schedules---to improve exploration and stability.
sentences.zh: 许多实用的采样器依赖时间相关的漂移项——通常由退火或回火调度所诱发——以改善探索性与稳定性。

sentences.en: This motivates a unified non-asymptotic analysis of the corresponding Langevin diffusion and their discretizations.
sentences.zh: 这促使我们对相应的朗之万扩散及其离散化进行统一的非渐近分析。

sentences.en: We provide a convergence analysis that includes non-asymptotic bounds for the continuous-time diffusion and its Euler--Maruyama discretization in the forward-Kullback--Leibler divergence under a single set of abstract conditions on the time-dependent drift.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了一种收敛性分析，在一组对时间相关漂移的抽象条件下，给出了连续时间扩散及其 Euler--Maruyama 离散化在前向 Kullback--Leibler 散度中的非渐近界。

sentences.en: The results apply to many practically-relevant annealing schemes, including geometric tempering and annealed Langevin sampling.
sentences.zh: 所得结果适用于许多实际相关的退火方案，包括几何回火与退火朗之万采样。

sentences.en: In addition, we provide numerical experiments comparing the annealing schemes covered by our theory in low- as well as high-dimensional settings.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提供了数值实验，在低维与高维设定下比较了我们的理论所涵盖的各种退火方案。

title_en: Foundation Inference Models for Ordinary Differential Equations
title_zh: 常微分方程的基础推断模型

sentences.en: Ordinary differential equations (ODEs) are central to scientific modelling, but inferring their vector fields from noisy trajectories remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 常微分方程（ODE）是科学建模的核心，但对带噪声的轨迹中推断其向量场仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Current approaches such as symbolic regression, Gaussian process (GP) regression, and Neural ODEs often require complex training pipelines and substantial machine learning expertise, or they depend strongly on system-specific prior knowledge.
sentences.zh: 符号回归、高斯过程（GP）回归和神经 ODE 等现有方法往往需要复杂的训练流程和大量的机器学习专业知识，或者严重依赖系统特定的先验知识。

sentences.en: We propose FIM-ODE, a pretrained Foundation Inference Model that *amortises* ODE inference by predicting the vector field directly from noisy trajectory data *in a single forward pass*.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 FIM-ODE，一种预训练的基础推理模型，它通过*单次前向传播*直接从带噪声的轨迹数据预测向量场，从而*摊销* ODE 推断。

sentences.en: We pretrain FIM-ODE on a prior distribution over ODEs with low-degree polynomial vector fields and represent the target field with neural operators.
sentences.zh: 我们在具有低次多项式向量场的 ODE 先验分布上预训练 FIM-ODE，并使用神经算子表示目标场。

sentences.en: FIM-ODE achieves strong *zero-shot* performance, matching and often improving upon ODEFormer, a recent pretrained symbolic baseline, across a range of regimes despite using a simpler training prior.
sentences.zh: 尽管使用了更简单的训练先验，FIM-ODE 在多种设定下都取得了强劲的*零样本*性能，匹配并常常超越近期预训练符号基线 ODEFormer。

sentences.en: Pretraining also provides a strong initialisation for finetuning, enabling fast and stable adaptation that outperforms modern neural and GP baselines without requiring machine learning expertise.
sentences.zh: 预训练还为微调提供了强大的初始化，无需机器学习专业知识即可实现快速且稳定的适配，且优于现代神经基线与 GP 基线。

sentences.en: Our pretrained model, code repository, and tutorials are available online.
sentences.zh: 我们的预训练模型、代码仓库与教程均已在线开放。

title_en: Foundation VAE for CT Reconstruction, Augmentation, and Generation
title_zh: 用于 CT 重建、增强与生成的基础变分自编码器

sentences.en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) compress high resolution CT volumes into compact latents while preserving clinically relevant structure.
sentences.zh: 变分自编码器（VAE）将高分辨率 CT 体积压缩为紧凑的潜在表示，同时保留具有临床相关性的结构。

sentences.en: However, training CT-specific VAEs from scratch or heavily fine-tuning them incurs substantial computational and engineering cost, and often degrades under heterogeneous scanners, protocols, and diseases.
sentences.zh: 然而，从零训练 CT 专用的 VAE 或对其进行大规模微调会带来可观的计算与工程成本，并且往往在异质扫描仪、协议与疾病条件下性能下降。

sentences.en: This paper makes a progressive stride toward training-free medical VAEs by leveraging a critical observation: a single Foundation VAE, pretrained at scale on natural images and videos, can serve as a unified interface for CT Reconstruction, Augmentation, and Generation.
sentences.zh: 本文利用一个关键观察，朝着免训练的医学 VAE 迈出了一步：在自然图像与视频上大规模预训练的单个基础 VAE（Foundation VAE），可以充当 CT 重建、增广与生成的统一接口。

sentences.en: With both encoder and decoder frozen, the Foundation VAE reconstructs CT volumes with preserved anatomy while suppressing acquisition noise; training segmentation models on these reconstructions improves surface accuracy by 3.9\% NSD on average for pancreatic tumor and lung tumor.
sentences.zh: 在编码器与解码器均冻结的情况下，基础 VAE 重建 CT 体积并保留解剖结构，同时抑制采集噪声；在这些重建上训练分割模型，可使胰腺肿瘤与肺肿瘤的平均表面准确率（NSD）提升 3.9\%。

sentences.en: Within the same Foundation VAE latent space, a conditional latent diffusion model achieves 3.9\% lower average FVD with 36.2\% higher CT CLIP score, and improves multi-disease generation faithfulness across 18 types by 2.76\% AUC.
sentences.zh: 在同一基础 VAE 潜空间中，条件潜扩散模型实现了平均 FVD 降低 3.9%、CT CLIP 分数提高 36.2%，并使 18 种疾病的多样生成忠实度提升 2.76% AUC。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate Foundation VAEs as a practical interface for scalable CT representation reuse and faithful CT generation.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，基础 VAE 是面向可扩展 CT 表征复用与忠实 CT 生成的实用接口。

sentences.en: Our code and demo are available at https://github.com/qic999/Foundation-VAE.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与演示可在 https://github.com/qic999/Foundation-VAE 获取。

authors.name: Nan Liu
authors.institution: Duke-NUS Medical School, National University of Singapore

title_en: Foundations of Equivariant Deep Learning: Unifying Graph and Sheaf Neural Networks
title_zh: 等变深度学习基础：统一图神经网络与层神经网络

sentences.en: We develop order-equivariant neural networks (OENN), which generalize standard graph message passing and sheaf neural networks via the face-poset viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 我们发展了序等变神经网络（OENN），它通过面-偏序集（face-poset）视角推广了标准的图消息传递与层状神经网络。

sentences.en: We (i) characterize all linear order-equivariant maps, (ii) build OENN layers, and (iii) prove a universal approximation theorem (UAT) for continuous order-equivariant maps, which is a new result even when restricted to sheaf neural networks (for which no UAT was known before).
sentences.zh: 我们 (i) 刻画了所有线性序等变映射，(ii) 构建了 OENN 层，以及 (iii) 证明了连续序等变映射的万能逼近定理（UAT），即使仅限于层状神经网络（此前尚无人为其证明 UAT）这也是一个新的结果。

sentences.en: We illustrate the framework on graph and sheaf models.
sentences.zh: 我们在图模型与层状模型上展示了该框架。

sentences.en: Our results can also be seen as extending the UAT for graph neural networks to a more general setting that subsumes sheaf neural networks as well.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果也可以看作是将图神经网络的 UAT 推广到一个更一般的设定，该设定同时包含了层状神经网络。

title_en: FoundObj: Self-supervised Foundation Models as Rewards for Label-free 3D Object Segmentation
title_zh: FoundObj：将自监督基础模型作为奖励，实现无标签三维物体分割

sentences.en: We address the challenging task of 3D object segmentation in complex scene point clouds without relying on any scene-level human annotations during training.
sentences.zh: 我们研究复杂场景点云中 3D 目标分割这一富有挑战性的任务，且训练过程中不依赖任何场景级人工标注。

sentences.en: Existing methods are typically constrained to identifying simple objects, primarily due to insufficient object priors in the learning process.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常局限于识别简单目标，主要原因在于学习过程中的目标先验不足。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present FoundObj, a novel framework featuring a superpoint-based object discovery agent that incrementally merges suitable neighboring superpoints, guided by our innovative semantic and geometric reward modules.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 FoundObj，一个新颖的框架，其核心是一个基于超点（superpoint）的目标发现智能体，在创新的语义奖励与几何奖励模块引导下，增量地合并合适的相邻超点。

sentences.en: These modules synergistically leverage semantic and geometric priors from self-supervised 2D/3D foundation models, providing complementary feedback to the object discovery agent and enabling robust identification of multi-class objects through reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 这些模块协同利用来自自监督 2D/3D 基础模型的语义先验与几何先验，为目标发现智能体提供互补反馈，并通过强化学习实现多类别目标的稳健识别。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法持续优于现有基线。

sentences.en: Notably, our method exhibits strong generalization in zero-shot and long-tail scenarios, underscoring its potential for scalable, label-free 3D object segmentation.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的方法在零样本与长尾场景中表现出强大的泛化能力，凸显了其进行可扩展、免标注 3D 目标分割的潜力。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/vLAR-group/FoundObj
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/vLAR-group/FoundObj 获取。

authors.name: Zihui Zhang
authors.institution: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Shenzhen Research Institute

authors.name: Yafei YANG
authors.institution: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Shenzhen Research Institute

title_en: Fourier Features Let Agents Learn High Precision Policies with Imitation Learning
title_zh: 傅里叶特征使智能体能够通过模仿学习获得高精度策略

sentences.en: High-precision robotic manipulation requires fine-grained spatial reasoning that is often difficult to achieve with RGB-only policies due to depth ambiguity and perspective scale issues.
sentences.zh: 高精度机器人操作需要细粒度的空间推理，而由于深度模糊与透视尺度问题，这往往难以仅凭 RGB 策略实现。

sentences.en: Policies that leverage 3D information directly, such as those based on point clouds, offer a stronger geometric prior over purely image-based ones, yet their performance remains highly task-dependent.
sentences.zh: 直接利用 3D 信息的策略（例如基于点云的策略）相比纯图像策略提供了更强的几何先验，但其性能仍高度依赖于任务。

sentences.en: We hypothesize that this discrepancy may be due to the spectral bias of neural networks towards learning low frequency functions, which especially affects architectures conditioned on slow-moving Cartesian features.
sentences.zh: 我们假设这一差异可能源于神经网络对学习低频函数存在谱偏置，这尤其影响以慢速变化的笛卡尔特征为条件的架构。

sentences.en: We thus propose to map point clouds from Cartesian space into high-dimensional Fourier space, effectively equipping the point cloud encoder with direct access to high-frequency features.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出将点云从笛卡尔空间映射到高维傅里叶空间，从而有效地为点云编码器提供对高频特征的直接访问。

sentences.en: We experimentally validate the use of Fourier features on challenging manipulation tasks from the RoboCasa and ManiSkill3 benchmarks and on a real robot setup.
sentences.zh: 我们通过实验验证了傅里叶特征在 RoboCasa 与 ManiSkill3 基准的挑战性操作任务以及真实机器人装置上的使用效果。

sentences.en: Despite their simplicity, we find that Fourier features provide significant benefits across diverse encoder architectures and benchmarks and are robust across hyperparameters.
sentences.zh: 尽管方法简单，我们发现傅里叶特征在多样的编码器架构与基准上都带来了显著收益，并且对超参数稳健。

sentences.en: Our results indicate that Fourier features let policies leverage geometric details more effectively than Cartesian features, showing their potential as a general-purpose tool for point cloud-based imitation learning.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，与笛卡尔特征相比，傅里叶特征让策略更有效地利用几何细节，显示出其作为基于点云的模仿学习通用工具的潜力。

sentences.en: We provide source code and videos on our project page: https://fourier-il.github.io/fourier-il.
sentences.zh: 我们在项目主页提供了源代码与视频：https://fourier-il.github.io/fourier-il。

title_en: FourTune: Towards Fully 4-Bit Efficient Post-Training for Diffusion Models
title_zh: FourTune：迈向扩散模型全 4 比特高效后训练

sentences.en: Diffusion models have become a dominant paradigm for high-quality generative modeling, while post-training is essential for adapting them to diverse downstream applications.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型已成为高质量生成建模的主导范式，而训练后适配对于将其适应到多样下游应用至关重要。

sentences.en: However, post-training of large diffusion models is still challenging due to the prohibitive memory footprints and slow training speed, which existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods only partially address.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于内存足迹过大且训练速度缓慢，大型扩散模型的训练后适配仍然具有挑战性，现有的参数高效微调方法只能部分解决这些问题。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose FourTune, an efficient post-training framework for diffusion models based on an end-to-end W4A4G4 paradigm.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出 FourTune，一个基于端到端 W4A4G4 范式的扩散模型高效训练后适配框架。

sentences.en: FourTune introduces a triple-branch hybrid pipeline that augments the standard LoRA architecture with a frozen numerical stabilizer to isolate quantization-sensitive outliers, enabling stable training under native 4-bit computation.
sentences.zh: FourTune 引入了一个三重分支混合流水线，它在标准 LoRA 架构上增加一个冻结的数值稳定器，以隔离对量化敏感的异常值，从而支持在原生 4 位计算下进行稳定训练。

sentences.en: In addition, FourTune employs hardware-efficient block-wise quantization and customized fused kernels to support efficient quantized backpropagation and reduce memory bandwidth overhead.
sentences.zh: 此外，FourTune 采用硬件高效的分块量化与定制融合内核，以支持高效的量化反向传播并降低内存带宽开销。

sentences.en: Across customization, reinforcement learning, and distillation tasks, FourTune matches the quality of full-precision fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在定制、强化学习与蒸馏任务中，FourTune 达到了与全精度微调相当的质量。

sentences.en: On FLUX.1-dev (12B), FourTune reduces memory overhead by $2.25\times$ and increases end-to-end training throughput by $2.27\times$ compared to BF16 LoRA.
sentences.zh: 在 FLUX.1-dev（12B）上，与 BF16 LoRA 相比，FourTune 将内存开销降低了 $2.25\times$，并将端到端训练吞吐量提升了 $2.27\times$。

title_en: FOVI: A biologically-inspired foveated interface for deep vision models
title_zh: FOVI：用于深度视觉模型的生物启发中央凹式接口

sentences.en: Human vision is foveated, with variable resolution peaking at the center of a large field of view; this reflects an efficient trade-off for active sensing, allowing eye-movements to bring different parts of the world into focus with other parts of the world in context.
sentences.zh: 人类视觉是中央凹（foveated）的，分辨率可变，在大视野中心处达到峰值；这反映了主动感知的一种高效权衡，使得眼动能够将世界各个部分聚焦，同时让世界其他部分处于上下文中。

sentences.en: In contrast, most computer vision systems encode the visual world at a uniform resolution, raising challenges for processing full-field high-resolution images efficiently.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，大多数计算机视觉系统以均匀分辨率编码视觉世界，这给高效处理全视野高分辨率图像带来了挑战。

sentences.en: We propose a foveated vision interface (FOVI) based on the human retina and primary visual cortex (V1), that reformats a variable-resolution retina-like sensor array into a uniformly dense, V1-like sensor manifold.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种基于人类视网膜与初级视觉皮层（V1）的中央凹视觉接口（FOVI），它将可变分辨率的类视网膜传感器阵列重新格式化为均匀致密的类 V1 传感器流形。

sentences.en: Receptive fields are defined as k-nearest-neighborhoods (kNNs) on the sensor manifold, enabling kNN-convolution via a novel kernel mapping technique.
sentences.zh: 感受野被定义为传感器流形上的 k 近邻（kNN），从而通过一种新颖的核映射技术实现 kNN 卷积。

sentences.en: We demonstrate two use cases: (1) an end-to-end kNN-convolutional architecture, and (2) a foveated adaptation of the DINOv3 ViT foundation model, leveraging low-rank adaptation (LoRA).
sentences.zh: 我们展示了两个用例：(1) 一个端到端的 kNN 卷积架构，以及 (2) DINOv3 ViT 基础模型的中央凹适配，利用低秩适配（LoRA）。

sentences.en: These models provide competitive performance with a fraction of the pixels and computational cost of full resolution non-foveated baselines, opening pathways for efficient and scalable active sensing for high-resolution egocentric vision.
sentences.zh: 这些模型仅以全分辨率非中央凹基线的一小部分像素与计算成本，就实现了具有竞争力的性能，为高效、可扩展的高分辨率自我中心视觉主动感知开辟了道路。

sentences.en: Code (https://github.com/nblauch/fovi) and pre-trained models (https://huggingface.co/fovi-pytorch) are available.
sentences.zh: 代码（https://github.com/nblauch/fovi）与预训练模型（https://huggingface.co/fovi-pytorch）均可获取。

title_en: Fox in the Henhouse: Supply-Chain Backdoor Attacks Against Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 鸡舍中的狐狸：针对强化学习的供应链后门攻击

sentences.en: Existing backdoor attacks on Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically rely on unrealistic white-box access to victim parameters, rewards, or observations.
sentences.zh: 现有针对强化学习（RL）的后门攻击通常依赖不现现实的黑盒访问权限，即访问受害者参数、奖励或观测。

sentences.en: Inspired by real world behaviors, we introduce the Supply-Chain Backdoor (SCAB) attack to demonstrate that such assumptions are unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 受真实世界行为的启发，我们引入供应链后门（SCAB）攻击，以证明此类假设并无必要。

sentences.en: SCAB targets the common practice of training with third-party policies, poisoning the dataset solely through a black-box of legitimate agent-environment interactions.
sentences.zh: SCAB 针对使用第三方策略进行训练这一常见做法，仅通过合法智能体-环境交互的简单黑盒手段来投毒数据集。

sentences.en: With only 3% data corruption, SCAB demonstrates a peak attack success rate exceeding 90% and reduces victim returns by 80%.
sentences.zh: 仅凭 3% 的数据污染，SCAB 就展现出超过 90% 的峰值攻击成功率，并将受害者者回报降低了 80%。

sentences.en: These findings expose a critical vulnerability in the modern RL supply chain, highlighting that reliance on untrusted external agents constitutes a severe and practical security risk.
sentences.zh: 这些发现暴露了现代 RL 供应链中的一个关键漏洞，凸显出依赖不可信外部智能体构成了一种严重且实际的安全风险。

authors.name: Paul MONTAGUE
authors.institution: Defence Science and Technology Group, Australia

title_en: FPTQuant: Function-Preserving Transforms for LLM Quantization
title_zh: FPTQuant：用于大语言模型量化的函数保持变换

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) require substantial compute, and thus energy, at inference time.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在推理时需要大量的计算，因而也消耗大量能源。

sentences.en: While quantizing weights and activations is effective at improving efficiency, naive quantization of LLMs can significantly degrade performance due to large magnitude outliers.
sentences.zh: 虽然量化权重与激活能有效提升效率，但由于大量大幅值异常值的存在，对 LLM 进行朴素量化可能显著降低性能。

sentences.en: This paper describes FPTQuant, which introduces three novel, lightweight, and expressive function-preserving transforms (FPTs) to facilitate quantization of transformers: (1) a mergeable pre-RoPE transform for queries and keys, (2) a mergeable transform for values, (3) a cheap, dynamic scaling transform.
sentences.zh: 本文描述 FPTQuant，它引入了三种新颖、轻量且表达能力强的保函数变换（FPT），以促进 Transformer 的量化：(1) 面向查询与键的可合并 pre-RoPE 变换，(2) 面向值的可合并变换，(3) 廉价的自适应动态缩放变换。

sentences.en: By leveraging the equivariances and independencies inherent to canonical transformer operation, we designed these FPTs to maintain the model’s function while shaping the intermediate activation distributions to be more quantization friendly.
sentences.zh: 通过利用用标准 Transformer 运算中内在的等变性与独立性，我们设计了这些 FPT，以在保持模型函数的同时，将中间激活分布塑造得更利于量化。

sentences.en: FPTQuant requires no custom kernels and adds virtually no overhead during inference.
sentences.zh: FPTQuant 不需要定制内核，并在推理期间几乎不增加开销。

sentences.en: The FPTs are trained both locally to reduce outliers, and end-to-end such that the outputs of the quantized and full-precision models match.
sentences.zh: 这些 FPT 既进行局部训练以减少异常值，也进行端到端训练，使得量化模型与全精度模型的输出相匹配。

sentences.en: FPTQuant enables static INT4 quantization with minimal overhead and shows SOTA speed-up of up to 3.9x over FP.
sentences.zh: FPTQuant 以极小的开销实现静态 INT4 量化，并相对 FP 显示出最高 3.9x 的 SOTA 加速。

sentences.en: Empirically, FPTQuant has an excellent accuracy-speed trade-off—it is performing on par or exceeding most prior work and only shows slightly lower accuracy compared to a method that is up to 29% slower.
sentences.zh: 实证上，FPTQuant 具有出色的精度-速度权衡——它达到或超过大多数先前工作的性能，并且仅比一种慢高达 29% 的方法的精度略低。

title_en: FRACTAL: State Space Model with Fractional Recurrent Architecture for Computational Temporal Analysis of Long Sequences
title_zh: FRACTAL：具有分数阶循环架构的状态空间模型，用于长序列计算时间分析

sentences.en: Effective sequence modeling fundamentally requires balancing the retention of unbounded history with the high-resolution detection of abrupt short-term variations common in real-world phenomena.
sentences.zh: 有效的序列建模从根本上要求在保留无界历史与高分辨率检测现实世界现象中常见的突发短期变化之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: However, existing state space models (SSMs) relying on high-order polynomial projection operators (HiPPO) face a critical trade-off where uniform measures dilute recent information to maintain timescale invariance, while exponential measures sacrifice global context to capture local dynamics.
sentences.zh: 然而，依赖高阶多项式投影算子（HiPPO）的现有状态空间模型（SSM）面临一个关键的权衡：均匀度量为了维持时间尺度不变性而稀释近期信息，指数度量则以牺牲全局上下文为代价来捕获局部动态。

sentences.en: This paper proposes a Fractional Recurrent Architecture for Computational Temporal Analysis of Long sequences (FRACTAL), a novel architecture integrating fractional measure theory into recursive memory updates to address this limitation.
sentences.zh: 本文提出面向长序列计算式时间分析的分数阶循环架构（FRACTAL），一种将分数阶测度论整合到递归记忆更新中的新颖架构，以解决这一局限。

sentences.en: By deriving projection operators with analytically characterized spectral properties and a tunable singularity index, the proposed method amplifies sensitivity to recent signal perturbations while preserving the spectral structure that encodes scale-invariant memory dynamics.
sentences.zh: 通过推导具有解析刻画谱性质与可调奇异指数的投影算子，所提方法在保持编码尺度不变记忆动力学的谱结构的同时，增强了对近期信号扰动的敏感性。

sentences.en: This theoretical innovation is instantiated within a simplified diagonalized state space framework by modulating input projection initialization to enable simultaneous capture of multi-scale temporal features.
sentences.zh: 这一理论创新在简化的对角化状态空间框架中通过调制输入投影初始化得以实例化，从而能够同时捕获多尺度时间特征。

sentences.en: FRACTAL achieves an average score of 87.11\% on the Long Range Arena benchmark, including 61.85\% on the ListOps task, outperforming the S5 model.
sentences.zh: FRACTAL 在 Long Range Arena 基准上取得了 87.11\% 的平均分数，其中 ListOps 任务达到 61.85\%，优于 S5 模型。

authors.name: Mengqi Li
authors.institution: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Northwest Polytechnical University Xi'an

title_en: Fractional is Better: Learnable Derivative Orders in Neural Operator Learning
title_zh: 分数阶更好：神经算子学习中的可学习导数阶数

sentences.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, enabling fast surrogate solutions to partial differential equations.
sentences.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，从而能够快速代理求解偏微分方程。

sentences.en: Despite remarkable architectural diversity, these methods often share a common input representation: raw coordinate-value pairs $(x, u(x))$.
sentences.zh: 尽管架构多种多样，这些方法往往共享一种共同的输入表示：原始坐标-值对 $(x, u(x))$。

sentences.en: We ask whether inputs aligned with PDE differential structure can improve learning.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨与 PDE 微分结构对齐的输入是否能够改善学习。

sentences.en: Through Picard iteration on mild solutions, we show that derivatives of the input appear explicitly in the solution operator, suggesting that providing derivative features should reduce the network's implicit differentiation burden.
sentences.zh: 通过对温和解的 Picard 迭代，我们表明输入的导数会显式出现在解算子中，这暗示提供导数特征应当减轻网络的隐式微分负担。

sentences.en: We prove this intuition: providing derivative features improves approximation rates from $O(W^{-(s-m)/d})$ to $O(W^{-s/d})$, where $W$ is network width, $s$ is input regularity, $m$ is the PDE order, and $d$ is spatial dimension.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了这一直觉：提供导数特征可将逼近率从 $O(W^{-(s-m)/d})$ 提升到 $O(W^{-s/d})$，其中 $W$ 是网络宽度，$s$ 是输入正则性，$m$ 是 PDE 阶数，$d$ 是空间维度。

sentences.en: Our central finding, however, is a surprise: the optimal derivative order $\beta^*$ is strictly less than the PDE order $m$.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的核心发现令人意外：最优导数阶数 $\beta^*$ 严格小于 PDE 阶数 $m$。

sentences.en: This gap arises from a bias-variance tradeoff in spectral space that we characterize in closed form.
sentences.zh: 这一差距源于谱空间中的偏差-方差权衡，我们对其进行了闭式刻画。

sentences.en: Learning $\beta$ from data achieves automatic spectral regularization.
sentences.zh: 从数据中学习 $\beta$ 可实现自动谱正则化。

sentences.en: We introduce $\partial$-NO (del-NO), for derivative-augmented neural operators, an architecture-agnostic augmentation that provides learnable fractional derivative features to any neural operator backbone.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 $\partial$-NO（del-NO），即导数增强神经算子，一种与架构无关的增强，为任何神经算子主干提供可学习的分数阶导数特征。

sentences.en: Across benchmark problems and architectures, $\partial$-NO consistently improves prediction accuracy, with learned orders that reflect a representation of known physics modulated by noise and finite-sample constraints.
sentences.zh: 在基准问题与各种架构上，$\partial$-NO 持续提升预测准确率，其所学阶数反映了一种受噪声与有限样本约束调制的已知物理表示。

title_en: FrameOracle: Learning What to See and How Much to See in Videos
title_zh: FrameOracle：学习在视频中看什么、看多少

sentences.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) advance video understanding but operate under tight computational budgets, making performance dependent on selecting a small, high-quality subset of frames.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）推动了视频理解的发展，但它们必须在紧张的计算预算下运行，这使得性能取决于选择一小部分高质量帧。

sentences.en: Existing frame sampling strategies, such as uniform or fixed-budget selection, fail to adapt to variations in content density or task complexity.
sentences.zh: 现有的帧采样策略，如均匀采样或固定预算选择，无法适应内容密度或任务复杂度的变化。

sentences.en: To address this, we present FrameOracle, a lightweight, plug-and-play module that predicts both (1) which frames are most relevant to a given query and (2) how many frames are needed.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 FrameOracle，一个轻量级、即插即用的模块，它同时预测 (1) 哪些帧与给定查询最相关，以及 (2) 需要多少帧。

sentences.en: FrameOracle is trained via a curriculum that progresses from weak proxy signals, such as cross-modal similarity, to stronger supervision with FrameOracle-41K, the first large-scale VideoQA dataset with validated keyframe annotations specifying minimal sufficient frames per question.
sentences.zh: FrameOracle 通过一种课程进行训练，从跨模态相似性等弱代理信号，逐步过渡到由 FrameOracle-41K 提供的更强监督——这是首个带有经过验证的关键帧注释（即指定每个问题所需的最小充分帧数）的大规模 VideoQA 数据集。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across five VLMs and six benchmarks show that FrameOracle reduces 16-frame inputs to an average of 10.4 frames without accuracy loss.
sentences.zh: 在五个 VLM 与六个基准上的大量实验表明，FrameOracle 将 16 帧输入平均减少到 10.4 帧而无准确率损失。

sentences.en: When starting from 64-frame candidates, it reduces inputs to 13.9 frames on average while improving accuracy by 1.5%, achieving state-of-the-art efficiency–accuracy trade-offs for scalable video understanding.
sentences.zh: 当从 64 帧候选项出发时，它将输入平均减少到 13.9 帧，同时将准确率提升 1.5%，为可扩展视频理解实现了最先进的效率-准确率权衡。

title_en: FreeRet: MLLMs as Training-Free Retrievers
title_zh: FreeRet：将多模态大语言模型用作无需训练的检索器

sentences.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are emerging as versatile foundations for mixed-modality retrieval.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正成为混合模态检索的多功能基础。

sentences.en: Yet, they often require heavy post-hoc training to convert them into contrastive encoders for retrieval.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们往往需要大量的事后训练，才能转换为用于检索的对比编码器。

sentences.en: This work asks: \textit{Can off-the-shelf MLLMs serve as powerful retrievers without additional training?}
sentences.zh: 本工作提出这样一个问题：\textit{开箱即用的 MLLM 能否在无需额外训练的情况下充当强大的检索器？}

sentences.en: We present \textbf{FreeRet}, a plug‑and‑play framework that turns any MLLM into a two‑stage retriever.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \textbf{FreeRet}，一个即插即用的框架，可将任何 MLLM 转化为两阶段检索器。

sentences.en: FreeRet first derives semantically grounded embeddings directly from the model for fast candidate search, and then exploits its reasoning ability for precise reranking.
sentences.zh: FreeRet 首先直接从模型中导出语义扎根的嵌入，用于快速候选搜索，然后利用其推理能力进行精确重排。

sentences.en: The framework contributes three advances: bypassing lexical alignment layers to obtain semantically faithful embeddings, conditioning representation generation with explicit priors, and mitigating framing effect in reranking via neutral choice framing.
sentences.zh: 该框架贡献了三大进展：绕过词法对齐层以获得语义忠实的嵌入、用显式先验调节表征生成、以及通过中性选择框架缓解重排中的框架效应。

sentences.en: On the MMEB and MMEB-V2, FreeRet substantially outperforms models trained on millions of pairs.
sentences.zh: 在 MMEB 与 MMEB-V2 上，FreeRet 大幅优于经过数百万对数据训练的模型。

sentences.en: Beyond benchmarks, FreeRet is model-agnostic and scales seamlessly across MLLM families and sizes, preserves their generative abilities, supports arbitrary modality combinations, and unifies retrieval, reranking, and generation into end-to-end RAG within a single model.
sentences.zh: 除基准之外，FreeRet 与模型无关，能够无缝扩展到不同 MLLM 系列与规模，保留其生成能力，支持任意模态组合，并将检索、重排与生成统一为单一模型内的端到端 RAG。

sentences.en: Our findings demonstrate that pretrained MLLMs, when carefully harnessed, can serve as strong retrieval engines without training, closing a critical gap in their role as generalists.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，经过精心利用的预训练 MLLM 可以在无需训练的情况下充当强大的检索引擎，从而弥合其作为通用专家角色中的关键空白。

title_en: FreeText: Training-Free Text Rendering via Attention Localization and Spectral Glyph Injection
title_zh: FreeText：通过注意力定位与频谱字形注入实现无需训练的文本渲染

sentences.en: Large-scale text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models excel at open-domain synthesis but still struggle with precise text rendering, especially for multi-line layouts, dense typography, and long-tailed scripts such as Chinese.
sentences.zh: 大规模文本到图像像（T2I）扩散模型擅长开放域合成，但仍然难以实现精确的文本渲染，尤其是多层次布局、密集排版以及中文等长尾文字。

sentences.en: Prior solutions typically necessitate costly retraining or impose rigid external layout constraints, often compromising aesthetic quality and flexibility.
sentences.zh: 先前的解决方案通常需要昂贵的重新训练，或施加僵化的外部布局约束，往往牺牲美感与灵活性。

sentences.en: We propose **FreeText**, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that improves text rendering by leveraging intrinsic mechanisms of *Diffusion Transformer (DiT)* models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **FreeText**，一个免训练、即插即用的框架，通过利用 *扩散 Transformer（DiT）* 模型的内在机制来改善文本渲染。

sentences.en: **FreeText** decomposes the problem into *where to write* and *what to write*.
sentences.zh: **FreeText** 将问题分解为*在哪写*与*写什么*两个方面。

sentences.en: For the former, we localize writing regions by extracting token-wise spatial attribution from image-to-text attention, using sink-like tokens as stable spatial anchors and topology-aware refinement to produce high-confidence masks.
sentences.zh: 对于前者，我们通过从图像到文本的注意力中提取逐 token 的空间归因来定位书写区域，使用类汇点（sink-like）token 作为稳定的空间锚点，并通过拓扑感知精化产生高置信掩码。

sentences.en: For the latter, we introduce Spectral-Modulated Glyph Injection (SGMI), which injects a noise-aligned glyph prior with frequency-domain band-pass modulation to strengthen glyph structure and mitigate semantic leakage (rendering the concept instead of the word).
sentences.zh: 对于后者，我们引入频谱调制字形注入（SGMI），它通过频域带通调制注入与噪声对齐的字形先验，以增强字形结构并缓解语义泄漏（渲染概念而非单词）。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on Qwen-Image, FLUX.1-dev, and SD3 variants across longText-Benchmark, CVTG, and our CLT-Bench show consistent gains in text readability while maintaining semantic alignment and aesthetic quality, with modest inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 在 Qwen-Image、FLUX.1-dev 与 SD3 变体上，跨 longText-Benchmark、CVTG 以及我们的 CLT-Bench 的大量实验表明，在保持语义对齐与审美质量并仅带来适度推理开销的同时，文本可读性获得了持续提升。

title_en: Frequency Matching in Spiking Neural Networks for mmWave Sensing
title_zh: 用于毫米波感知的脉冲神经网络频率匹配

sentences.en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) sensing enables privacy-preserving, always-on edge perception, but its measurements are often sparse, temporally irregular, and corrupted by high-frequency noise.
sentences.zh: 毫米波（mmWave）感知能够实现隐隐私保护、常开的边缘感知，但其测量往往稀疏、时间上不规则，并受到高频噪声的破坏。

sentences.en: Existing mmWave pipelines predominantly rely on artificial neural networks (ANNs), which achieve robustness through extensive preprocessing or deep architectures, thereby limiting their efficiency on edge devices.
sentences.zh: 现有的毫米波流程主要依赖人工神经网络（ANN），它们通过大量的预处理或深层架构来获得鲁棒性，从而限制了其在边缘设备上的效率。

sentences.en: In this work, we study spiking neural networks (SNNs) for mmWave sensing from a mechanism–data alignment perspective.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从机制-数据对齐的视角研究用于毫米波感知的脉冲神经网络（SNN）。

sentences.en: By leveraging the low-pass filtering behavior of leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) dynamics, we analyze how their implicit temporal filtering interacts with the frequency structure of mmWave signals.
sentences.zh: 通过利用泄漏积分-发放（LIF）动力学的低通滤波行为，我们分析其隐式时间滤波如何与毫米波信号的频率结构相互作用。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that when discriminative information resides in low-to-mid frequencies, LIF dynamics can inherently suppress high-frequency noise, clarifying when and why SNNs outperform ANNs.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，当判别信息位于低到中频时，LIF 动力学能够内在地抑制高频噪声，从而厘清了 SNN 何时以及为何优于 ANN。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we derive a principled criterion for configuring the membrane decay factor by matching the effective bandwidth of LIF dynamics to the data’s discriminative spectral content.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们推导出一个原理性的准则，通过将 LIF 动力学的有效带宽与数据的判别性频谱内容相匹配，来配置膜衰减因子。

sentences.en: Experimental results across four widely used mmWave datasets validate the proposed frequency-matching hypothesis, yielding an average test-accuracy improvement of 6.22% and a 3.64× reduction in theoretical energy consumption relative to ANN baselines, under a unified evaluation protocol.
sentences.zh: 在四个广泛使用的毫米波数据集上的实验结果验证了所提出的频率匹配假设，在统一的评估协议下，相比 ANN 基线实现了平均测试准确率提升 6.22%，以及理论能量消耗降低 3.64×。

title_en: Frequency-Aware Perceptual Optimization for Low-Complexity Implicit Image Compression
title_zh: 用于低复杂度隐式图像压缩的频率感知感知优化

sentences.en: We propose a frequency-aware perceptual optimization framework for low-complexity image compression, realized as a **Re**alism-enhanced **Re**gion-based **I**mplicit **C**odec (Re2IC).
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种面向低复复杂度图像压缩的频率感知感知优化框架，实现为 **R**ealism-enhanced **R**egion-based **I**mplicit **C**odec（Re2IC）编解码器。

sentences.en: Re2IC models visual perception via saliency-guided region partitioning and local–global perceptual modulation.
sentences.zh: Re2IC 通过显著性引导的区域划分与局部-全局感知调制来建模视觉感知。

sentences.en: To enhance realism under complexity constraints, we introduce wavelet–Wasserstein distortion (WA-WD), a frequency-decomposed perceptual distortion that balances fidelity and realism through subband-aware modeling and provides a more reliable approximation than standard Wasserstein distortion.
sentences.zh: 为在复杂度约束下增强真实感，我们引入小波-Wasserstein 失真（WA-WD），一种频率分解的感知失真，通过子带感知建模在保真度与真实感之间取得平衡，并提供比标准 Wasserstein 失真更可靠的近似。

sentences.en: Together, these designs enable fine-grained spatial–spectral optimization, allowing Re2IC to achieve superior rate–perception trade-offs, outperforming generative codecs such as HiFiC while using less than 1\% of their decoding cost.
sentences.zh: 这些设计共同实现了细粒度的空间-频谱优化，使 Re2IC 能够取得优越的率-感知权衡，在解码成本不到 HiFiC 等生成式编解码器 1\% 的情况下超越它们。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art perceptual performance among overfitted codecs.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在过拟合编解码器中，其感知性能达到了最先进的水平。

sentences.en: Beyond compression, WA-WD serves as a standalone, tunable perceptual metric with strong alignment to human preference (Pearson 94.6\%, Spearman 92.3\%) and competitive performance across multiple IQA benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 除压缩之外，WA-WD 还可以作为独立、可调的感知度量，与人类偏好高度对齐（Pearson 94.6\%，Spearman 92.3\%），并在多个 IQA 基准上表现优异。

sentences.en: Project page: https://eedavidwu.github.io/ReReIC/
sentences.zh: 项目主页：https://eedavidwu.github.io/ReReIC/

title_en: Frequentist Consistency of Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Causal Inference
title_zh: 用于因果推断的先验数据拟合网络的频率学派一致性

sentences.en: Foundation models based on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have shown strong empirical performance in causal inference by framing the task as an in-context learning problem.
sentences.zh: 基于先前数据拟合网络（PFN）的基础模型通过将任务框架化为上下文内学习问题，在因果推断中表现出强大的实证性能。

sentences.en: However, it is unclear whether PFN-based causal estimators provide uncertainty quantification that is consistent with classical frequentist estimators.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前尚不清楚基于 PFN 的因果估计器所提供的不确定性量化，是否与经典频率派估计器相一致。

sentences.en: In this work, we address this gap by analyzing the frequentist consistency of PFN-based estimators for the average treatment effect (ATE).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过分析基于 PFN 的平均处理效应（ATE）估计器的频率派一致性，来弥合这一空白。

sentences.en: (1) We show that existing PFNs, when interpreted as Bayesian ATE estimators, can exhibit prior-induced confounding bias: the prior is not asymptotically overwritten by data, which, in turn, prevents frequentist consistency.
sentences.zh: (1) 我们表明，当把现有 PFN 解释为贝叶斯 ATE 估计器时，它们可能出现由先验引发的混杂偏差：先验不会随着数据的增加而渐近地覆盖，这反过来阻碍了频率派一致性。

sentences.en: (2) As a remedy, we suggest employing a calibration procedure based on a one-step posterior correction (OSPC).
sentences.zh: (2) 作为一种补救措施，我们建议采用基于单步后验校正（OSPC）的校准程序。

sentences.en: We show that the OSPC helps to restore frequentist consistency and can yield a semi-parametric Bernstein-von Mises theorem for calibrated PFNs (i.e., both the calibrated PFN-based estimators and the classical semi-parametric efficient estimators converge in distribution with growing data size).
sentences.zh: 我们表明 OSPC 有助于恢复频率派一致性，并能针对校准后的 PFN 产生半参数 Bernstein-von Mises 定理（即，随着数据规模增长，校准后的基于 PFN 的估计器与经典半参数有效估计器在分布上收敛）。

sentences.en: (3) Finally, we implement OSPC through tailoring martingale posteriors on top of the PFNs.
sentences.zh: (3) 最后，我们通过在 PFN 之上定制鞅后验来实现 OSPC。

sentences.en: In this way, we are able to recover functional nuisance posteriors from PFNs, required by the OSPC.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，我们能够从 PFN 中恢复 OSPC 所需的函数型干扰后验。

sentences.en: In multiple  (semi-)synthetic experiments, PFNs calibrated with our martingale posterior OSPC produce ATE uncertainty that (i) asymptotically matches frequentist uncertainty and (ii) is well calibrated in finite samples in comparison to other Bayesian ATE estimators.
sentences.zh: 在多个（半）合成实验中，用我们的鞅后验 OSPC 校准的 PFN 所产生的 ATE 不确定性，(i) 渐近地匹配频率派不确定性，(ii) 与其他贝叶斯 ATE 估计器相比，在有限样本下校准良好。

title_en: Frictional Q-Learning
title_zh: 摩擦式 Q 学习

sentences.en: Off-policy reinforcement learning suffers from extrapolation errors when a learned policy selects actions that are weakly supported in the replay buffer.
sentences.zh: 当学到的策略选择回放缓冲区中支持较弱的动作时，离策略强化学习学习往往会遭受外推误差。

sentences.en: In this study, we address this issue by drawing an analogy to static friction.
sentences.zh: 在本研究中，我们通过类比静摩擦力来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: From this perspective, the replay buffer is represented as a smooth, low-dimensional action manifold, where the support directions correspond to the tangential component, while the normal component captures the dominant first-order extrapolation error.
sentences.zh: 从这一视角出发，回放缓冲区被表示为光滑的低维动作流形，其中支持方向对应切向分量，而法向分量则捕获主导的一阶外推误差。

sentences.en: This decomposition reveals an intrinsic anisotropy in value sensitivity that naturally induces a stability condition analogous to a friction threshold.
sentences.zh: 这种分解揭示了价值敏感性中内在的各向异性，自然产生了一种类似于摩擦阈值的稳定性条件。

sentences.en: To mitigate deviations toward unsupported actions, we propose Frictional Q-Learning, an off-policy algorithm that encodes supported actions as tangent directions using a contrastive variational autoencoder.
sentences.zh: 为减轻向不支持动作的偏移，我们提出摩擦式 Q 学习（Frictional Q-Learning），一种离策略算法，利用对比变分自编码器将受支持动作编码为切向方向。

sentences.en: We further show that an orthonormal basis of the orthogonal complement corresponds to normal components under mild local isometry assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，在温和的局部等距假设下，正交补空间的一组标准正交基对应法向分量。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical results on standard continuous-control benchmarks consistently demonstrate robust and stable performance compared with competitive baselines.
sentences.zh: 在标准连续控制基准上的大量实证结果一致表明，与具有竞争力的基线相比，本方法具有稳健且稳定的性能。

title_en: FRIGID: Scaling Diffusion-Based Molecular Generation from Mass Spectra at Training and Inference Time
title_zh: FRIGID：在训练与推理时扩展基于扩散的质谱到分子生成

sentences.en: Tandem mass spectrometry is prominent in scientific discovery workflows for identifying unknown small molecules, yet high-throughput structural elucidation remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 串联质谱法在识别未知小分子的科学发现流程中占有重要地位，然而高通量的结构解析仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: While recent autoregressive and graph diffusion models have shown promise in *de novo* elucidation, performance remains limited by poor scalability during both training and inference time.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的自回归模型与图扩散模型在 *从头* 解析方面显示出前景，但其性能仍受训练与推理阶段可扩展性不足的限制。

sentences.en: In this work, we present FRIGID, a framework with a novel diffusion language model that generates molecular structures conditioned on mass spectra via intermediate fingerprint representations and determined chemical formulae, training at the scale of hundreds of millions of unlabeled structures.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 FRIGID，一个带有新颖扩散语言模型的框架，它通过中间指纹表示与确定的化学式，以质谱为条件生成分子结构，并在数亿未标注结构的规模上进行训练。

sentences.en: We then demonstrate how forward fragmentation models enable inference-time scaling by identifying spectrum-inconsistent fragments and refining them through targeted remasking and denoising.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们展示了前向碎裂模型如何通过识别与谱不一致的片段，并通过对这些片段进行目标重掩码与去噪来精化，从而实现推理时扩展。

sentences.en: While FRIGID already achieves strong performance with its diffusion base, inference-time scaling significantly improves its accuracy, surpassing 18% Top-1 accuracy on the challenging MassSpecGym benchmark and tripling the Top-1 accuracy of the leading methods on NPLIB1.
sentences.zh: 虽然 FRIGID 凭借其扩散基础模型就已取得强劲性能，推理时扩展仍显著提升了其准确率，在具有挑战性的 MassSpecGym 基准上超过 18% 的 Top-1 准确率，并在 NPLIB1 上将领先方法的 Top-1 准确率提高了两倍。

sentences.en: Further empirical analyses show that FRIGID exhibits log-linear performance scaling with increasing inference-time compute, opening a promising new direction for continued improvements in *de novo* structural elucidation.
sentences.zh: 进一步的实证分析表明，FRIGID 随推理时计算量的增加表现出对数线性性能扩展，为 *从头* 结构解析的持续改进开辟了一个有前景的新方向。

sentences.en: FRIGID code is publicly available at https://github.com/coleygroup/FRIGID.
sentences.zh: FRIGID 代码可在 https://github.com/coleygroup/FRIGID 公开获取。

title_en: FRISM: Fine-Grained Reasoning Injection via Subspace-Level Model Merging for Vision–Language Models
title_zh: FRISM：通过子空间级模型合并向视觉语言模型注入细粒度推理能力

sentences.en: Efficiently enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by merging them with Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) has emerged as a promising direction.
sentences.zh: 通过将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与大推理模型（LRM）合并来高效增强其推理能力，已成为一个有前景的方向。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically operate at a coarse-grained layer level, which often leads to a trade-off between injecting reasoning capabilities and preserving visual capabilities.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常在粗粒度的层级别运作，往往导致在注入推理能力与保留视觉能力之间进行权衡。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose FRISM (Fine-grained Reasoning Injection via Subspace-level model Merging), a fine-grained reasoning injection framework based on subspace-level model merging.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出 FRISM（Fine-grained Reasoning Injection via Subspace-level model Merging），一个基于子空间级模型合并的细粒度推理注入框架。

sentences.en: Observing that different SVD subspaces contribute differently to reasoning and perception, FRISM decomposes LRM task vectors via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and adaptively tunes the scaling coefficients of each subspace through learning to realize fine-grained reasoning injection.
sentences.zh: 观察到不同的 SVD 子空间对推理与感知的贡献不同，FRISM 通过奇异值分解（SVD）分解 LRM 任务向量，并通过学习自适应地调节每个子空间的缩放系数，以实现细粒度的推理注入。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a label-free self-distillation learning strategy with dual-objective optimization using common vision-language perception datasets.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一种利用常见视觉-语言感知数据集的、带双目标优化的免标注自蒸馏学习策略。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that FRISM effectively improves reasoning capabilities while largely preserving the model's visual capabilities by consistently achieving strong performance across diverse visual-language reasoning benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，FRISM 在有效提升推理能力的同时，通过在多样视觉-语言推理基准上持续取得强劲性能，在很大程度上保留了模型的视觉能力。

title_en: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations for Multimodal Image Fusion
title_zh: 从二维网格到一维词元：重塑多模态图像融合的共享表征

sentences.en: Multimodal image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a fused image that preserves rich local details while maintaining globally consistent appearance.
sentences.zh: 多模态图像融合旨在将不同模态的互补信息整合为一张融合图像，既保留丰富的局部细节，又维持全局一致的外观。

sentences.en: Existing approaches build shared representations on 2D feature grids, which excel at modeling local structures but offer limited leverage over image-level global appearance factors.
sentences.zh: 现有方法在 2D 特征网格上构建共享表征，这擅长建模局部结构，但对图像级全局外观因素的掌控能力有限。

sentences.en: To balance these objectives, we introduce a compact 1D token interface based on a frozen pretrained image tokenizer for modeling non-local appearance/base factors.
sentences.zh: 为平衡这些目标，我们基于冻结的预训练图像分词器引入一个紧凑的 1D token 接口，用于建模非局部的外观/基因素。

sentences.en: Rather than using the tokenizer as a reconstruction backbone, our design uses the 1D token space as a global carrier while retaining the 2D spatial pathway for local structure restoration.
sentences.zh: 我们的设计并非将分词器用作重建主干，而是将 1D token 空间作为全局载体，同时保留 2D 空间通路用于局部结构恢复。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce Selective Token Editing (STE), which sparsely updates/replaces a small set of critical tokens, providing a lightweight mechanism to steer global appearance coherence while keeping the fusion backbone unchanged and avoiding extra losses.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入选择性 token 编辑（STE），它稀疏地更新或替换一小部分关键 token，提供一种轻量机制来引导全局外观一致性，同时保持融合主干不变并避免额外损失。

sentences.en: Experiments on four commonly used benchmarks show that our method achieves the best overall performance, with consistent, multi-metric improvements in both global coherence and local fidelity.
sentences.zh: 在四个常用基准上的实验表明，我们的方法取得了最佳的整体性能，在全局连贯性与局部保真度两方面都实现了持续、多指标的改进。
